cell_state_machine_g0.execution: pure deterministic Application; no SQL replay, I/O, clock or page publication
cell_state_machine_g0.state_format: SCAPCELL version 1; bounded binary codec and SHA-256
cell_state_machine_g0.command_format: SCAPCMD! version 1; bounded binary codec and SHA-256
cell_state_machine_g0.limits: replicated and compared to expected local configuration
cell_state_machine_g0.genesis: explicit bootstrap; identical nonempty application and snapshot atomically stored at term/index 1
cell_state_machine_g0.recovery_binding: same Store view cell identity and durable applied entry term/index; also required after snapshot-only install
cell_state_machine_g0.authorization: trusted admission followed by replicated current policy and auth_epoch recheck before historical replay
cell_state_machine_g0.audit_binding: original Admission retained in accepted transactions, cancellations and administrative records
cell_state_machine_g0.physical_payload: opaque bounded bytes with digest; engine format and baseline validation remain adapter responsibilities
cell_state_machine_g0.deduplication: semantic fingerprint distinct from physical digest; retain original receipt, position and result
cell_state_machine_g0.ordinary_rejection: only the attempted command at its exact term/index; not permanent request cancellation
cell_state_machine_g0.cancellation: persistent ordered ResolveOrCancel; absent Lookup remains Unknown
cell_state_machine_g0.retention: all accepted physical transactions and request/admin records; reject at capacity, no automatic GC
cell_state_machine_g0.recovery_api: trusted internal worker only; not an ordinary user READ export endpoint

sqlite_adapter_g0.sql_request_format: SCAPSQL1 exact SQL and typed positional parameters; SHA-256 fingerprint
sqlite_adapter_g0.sql_result_format: SCAPRES1 bounded complete typed transaction results
sqlite_adapter_g0.physical_format: SCAPIMG! version 1; fixed 4096-byte pages; full logical image base and result SHA-256
sqlite_adapter_g0.open_policy: fresh exclusive runtime-owned directory only; no old cache or sidecar reuse
sqlite_adapter_g0.recovery_policy: complete cell history from empty image after ReadIndex and decode_bound plus exact recovery target
sqlite_adapter_g0.physical_commit: pre-native-publish gate; ACK after durable business acceptance and final COMMIT success
sqlite_adapter_g0.no_physical_changes: same-image empty-page transaction and original result still committed through cell
sqlite_adapter_g0.idempotency: current-authorized preflight plus ordered commit-time check; historical receipt and result preserved
sqlite_adapter_g0.configuration: FULL sync; cache_spill OFF; no auto checkpoint; SQLite max_page_count bounded
sqlite_adapter_g0.sql_surface: private connection; explicit batch; deny unknown authorizer action/function
sqlite_adapter_g0.failure_policy: stop writer; retain accepted receipt for post-acceptance failures; never replay UNKNOWN automatically
